Context: (xiv) Simplification of referral system»

Advice of the CGHS Medical Officer I CGHS Specialist for listed treatment procedure shall be valid for a period of 3 months. If any listed investigation advised by Specialist of empanelled hospital is required urgently as a medical emergency and certified as such, may be undertaken at the same hospital. Hospitals are empanelled under CGHS for the Specialists available and not by the name of Specialists.
